name: pilot
description: Opt-in: the ship-pilot browser-interaction crew (screenshots, UI verification, form testing). Hard EXTERNAL dependency on the claude-in-chrome MCP server, which most installs lack — so it ships opt-in even in live doctrine and is dispatched only when the Captain explicitly authorizes browser access. Install with --modules pilot. Reuses core's crew-safety Bash hook (validate-crew-bash.sh); no hook of its own.
